content: For adults aged 65 years and older, it is recommended to administer either the PCV15 (15-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine) or the PCV20 (20-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine), followed by the PPSV23 (23-valent pneumococcal polysaccharide vaccine). For adults aged 19 to 64 years who are at increased risk (such as those with certain medical conditions or immunocompromised states), they should receive either the PCV15 or PCV20 if their vaccination status is unknown.
